fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the residence without obstruction.
• Designate and maintain a flat, firm area near the residence where emergency vehicles can turn around, as the current layout limits turnaround options.
• Trim dense vegetation along the access drive so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction and responders can move on foot alongside vehicles.
• Cut back vegetation growing close to the structure so responders can move around the exterior walls without obstruction.
• Keep the walkway clear of overgrowth so responders can move between the driveway and the residence on foot.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly so responding units can confirm entry and avoid bypassing the property.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree clusters near the structure to create open gaps between the trees and the building.
• Trim branches on large trees that extend over or within 10 feet of the structure's roof and walls.
• Remove or cut back shrubs growing directly against the structure on all sides.
• Mow or cut the grass cover around the structure, keeping it short especially close to the building.
• Separate scattered trees from one another where their branches touch or overlap near the structure.
• Trim overhanging branches along the driveway so vehicles, including fire trucks, can pass through without obstruction.
• Clear shrubs and low vegetation along both sides of the driveway to widen the travel path.
• Cut back vegetation that has grown into the driveway margins to keep the route visible and passable.
• Remove dead grass, fallen branches, and dry plant debris from the area immediately surrounding the structure.
• Thin shrubs and small trees between the structure and the open terrain to create wider gaps in the vegetation.
• Keep the area closest to the structure as clear as possible since it is surrounded by vegetation on multiple sides.
• Mark or sign the single driveway access point clearly so it is easy to locate from the road.
• Remove any shrubs or low-hanging branches that would block a driver's sightline along the driveway approach.
